records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] In browser_reporting_collector.py:41-46, both age and timestamp are required=False with no validate enforcing one-of, so a report with neither field validates cleanly; the endpoint accepts reports with no time anchoring at all, and future consumers assuming a time field exists hit KeyError/None silently.
records.rationale: In `BrowserReportSerializer`, both `age` and `timestamp` are `required=False` and the only validation present (`validate_timestamp` / `validate_age`) enforces mutual exclusion when one is provided, but does not enforce that at least one of them must be present.
